_why: Sentry: a very large Django monolith + React frontend, scanned without being importable, so routes were read from source (the scan itself warned it reached only 3 of 23 urls.py files). The scan produced 1568 claims (unresolved/unused) across 9 kinds. I sampled up to 12 per kind with random seed 0 (89 claims), read every claimed file:line, and grepped the repo for the missing counterpart. 87 claims were judged true/false (2 css_selector samples were edge cases and are excluded). Result: 38 true, 49 false. Dominant false patterns: Celery tasks registered via @instrumented_task(name=...) (12/12 false, likely all 67), Django URL names living in the unread urls.py files (12/12 url_reference + 2 fetch_target false), test-file strings treated as production seams (12 false: HTTP URLs in test client.get() misparsed as redis keys, mocked jest fetches, digests-backend test reads), .less stylesheets not parsed (8 dom_attr false), and redis/cache keys built by helper-function f-strings (2 false).
